crossRefs.note: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
With my whole heart, I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.
I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

parallels.note: For I have kept Yahweh’s ways, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

translations.web: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
translations.bsb: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
translations.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
translations.asv: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
